Receipt call_nsr90byq (node test.js, exit 0) is truncated before its stdout tail and timestamp, so it is unconfirmed whether the 148/148 run executed against the final server.js. Consequence: the completion claim may describe stale source. Suggested verification: re-run `node test.js` on the final source and link an untruncated receipt showing the `passed=148 failed=0` summary line with a timestamp after the last file write.

Receipt call_wowogcw7 (ls -la) is truncated before the directory listing, so the claim that fixtures were removed and only the two files remain is unconfirmed from evidence; verify with a full directory listing receipt after the final test run.

Non-blocking observation from source review: value length is enforced in UTF-16 code units (String.length), so a value of 128 astral-plane characters (256 code units) would be rejected; this is a defensible reading of 'at most 128 characters' and the test uses BMP characters, but the interpretation should be stated if strict code-point semantics are required.
